cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: What Rule Did I Miss?
cards.instruction: Find the hidden rule that makes the strange situation consistent, practical, or at least survivable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Your shadow moved before you. What changed?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was thinking of leaving, but I can't find the exit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Think about that bench without moving. Does it turn?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's gone to the bench. I'm still here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It seems to follow your intentions. Think about the exit again; let's follow slowly and see whether it knows the way.
